intro: Detroit rewards visitors with world-class museums, a resurgent downtown, and a gritty creative spirit. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: QLine streetcar runs along Woodward Ave from downtown to New Center; fare $1.50 for 3 hours.
People Mover loops downtown; fare $0.75 per ride.
SMART and DDOT buses cover the metro; fare $2.
Ride apps Uber and Lyft are widely used; taxis also available.
Driving is easiest; freeways are modern but rush hour can be slow.
Walking is good downtown; biking is growing with rental options.

dia.name: Detroit Institute of Arts
dia.price_text: About $20 adults · check current price and free days online
dia.hours: Closed Monday · Tue–Thu and Sat–Sun roughly 09:00–17:00 · Fri to about 21:00 · check on the day
dia.tip: The Rivera Court murals alone are worth the trip. Allow at least two hours.

motown.name: Motown Museum
motown.hours: Closed Monday and Tuesday · Wed–Sun roughly 10:00–18:00 · check on the day
motown.tip: Tours are guided and sell out. Book online before you travel.

hungry-howies.name: Hungry Howie's
hungry-howies.price_text: About $8–15 per pizza · varies by branch
hungry-howies.hours: Most branches roughly 11:00–23:00 · check your branch
hungry-howies.tip: Michigan-born chain known for flavored crust. Ask for the butter or garlic crust.

little-caesars.name: Little Caesars
little-caesars.hours: Most branches roughly 10:30–22:00 · check your branch
little-caesars.tip: Detroit-founded chain. Grab a cheap hot-and-ready pizza and eat in the park.

eastern-market.name: Eastern Market
eastern-market.price_text: Free to enter · pay per item
eastern-market.hours: Saturday market roughly 06:00–16:00 · other days limited · check on the day
eastern-market.tip: Come Saturday morning for the big outdoor market and food stalls.

riverwalk.name: Detroit RiverWalk
riverwalk.hours: Open daily, roughly dawn to dusk
riverwalk.tip: Walk east toward the bridge for skyline and Canada views at sunset.

belle-isle.name: Belle Isle Park
belle-isle.price_text: Free entry · state park vehicle pass may apply
belle-isle.tip: Bring a car or bike. The conservatory and aquarium are free and good for families.

corktown-walk.name: Corktown neighbourhood walk
corktown-walk.price_text: Free · pay for food and drinks
corktown-walk.hours: Any time · bars and cafes vary
corktown-walk.tip: Detroit's oldest neighbourhood. Walk Michigan Avenue for old brick streets and cafes.

greektown-walk.name: Greektown walk
greektown-walk.tip: Compact historic block near downtown. Good for a meal and a short evening stroll.

fisher-building.name: Fisher Building lobby
fisher-building.hours: Lobby roughly 07:00–19:00 weekdays · check on the day
fisher-building.tip: Look up at the painted vaulted ceiling. Quick, free and photogenic.

guardian-building.name: Guardian Building lobby
guardian-building.hours: Lobby roughly 08:00–18:00 weekdays · check on the day
guardian-building.tip: Art Deco tilework inside. Pop in for ten minutes while downtown.

downtown-tour.name: Downtown walking or bus tour
downtown-tour.hours: Tours usually run mornings and afternoons · book ahead
downtown-tour.tip: A guided intro helps first-timers link downtown sights. Confirm meeting point and price.

campus-martius.name: Campus Martius Park
campus-martius.hours: Open daily · ice rink in winter
campus-martius.tip: Central downtown square. Good rest stop; ice skating in winter.

coney-island.name: Coney Island hot dog
coney-island.hours: Classic spots roughly 07:00–20:00 · check on the day
coney-island.tip: Detroit classic: chili dog with mustard and onions. Try a local diner downtown.

dime-store.name: Detroit riverfront and skyline viewpoint
dime-store.tip: Best skyline and river views from the RiverWalk near the bridge.

midtown-walk.name: Midtown cultural walk
midtown-walk.price_text: Free · pay for museums and food
midtown-walk.hours: Any time · museums have their own hours
midtown-walk.tip: Link the DIA and Motown Museum on foot with cafes in between.

greek-food.name: Greektown dinner
greek-food.hours: Restaurants roughly 11:00–23:00 · check on the day
greek-food.tip: Book ahead on weekends. Try Greek classics and share plates.

corktown-food.name: Corktown cafe and bar stop
corktown-food.hours: Cafes and bars vary · check on the day
corktown-food.tip: Pair a coffee with a short walk along Michigan Avenue.

riverfront-bike.name: Riverfront bike ride
riverfront-bike.price_text: About $10–20 per hour rental · check on the day
riverfront-bike.tip: Rent a bike and ride the RiverWalk path. Bring water in summer.

eastern-market-food.name: Eastern Market food stop
eastern-market-food.hours: Saturday roughly 06:00–16:00 · check on the day
eastern-market-food.tip: Try local produce and prepared food on Saturday morning.

downtown-park.name: Downtown evening stroll
downtown-park.tip: Walk from Campus Martius to the RiverWalk for an easy evening loop.

styles.blurb: Motown, the Detroit Institute of Arts and Eastern Market.

styles.label: History

styles.label: Family
styles.blurb: Science center, zoo and riverfront parks for kids.

stays.why: Walk to the riverfront, stadiums and the People Mover; easiest base without a car.
Next to the Detroit Institute of Arts and the Motown Museum; QLine streetcar to downtown.
Quiet, historic streets with bars and cafés; short ride to downtown and the riverfront.
Restaurants and nightlife on the doorstep; People Mover stop and walk to downtown sights.

food: Try a Detroit-style square pizza: thick, crispy edges and cheese to the rim. Many local spots serve it.
Coney Island hot dogs are a Detroit staple; several long-running diners downtown and nearby.
Eastern Market on a Saturday morning: produce, food stalls and a lively local crowd.
Greektown is the place for Greek restaurants and late dinners near downtown.
Middle Eastern food in Dearborn, a short drive west, is a local favourite; check hours before you go.
more_time: Add a day for Dearborn: the Henry Ford Museum and Greenfield Village show the auto and American history story.
Cross the river to Windsor, Canada for a different view of the skyline; bring your passport and check border rules.
Sports fans can swap a museum afternoon for a Tigers, Lions, Red Wings or Pistons game; check the schedule and prices on the day.
